I recall this being profiled on Unsolved Mysteries and when Ridgway was busted in 2001, I was surprised. I figured it would be a Zodiac scenario. The Green River Killer is a big name so I'm probably not going to point out to many details. What shocks me most about serial killers is also not uncommon: the ability for a person to maintain a seemingly normal life and then have another part of their life where they are committing these heinous acts. Ridgway certainly meets that standard. I know he had a son (whose picture he sometimes used to lure victims) and I wonder how deeply these revelations must affect him.
